name: Tidewater 3: CRM
description: Call to CRM (project 8): CRM adapter. Reads deals and writes notes, tasks and deal fields in HubSpot (live) or the Tidewater tables (test).

parameters.content:
## Tidewater 3: CRM
The only place that talks to the CRM, so the rest of the system doesn't care which one it is.
- **get_deal**: the deal with its company, contacts and recent activity.
- **update_deal**: changes only the fields given (stage, amount, close date, next step).
- **add_note** / **create_task**: logged on the deal.
Test mode uses the **Tidewater** tables. Live mode uses the HubSpot CRM API (deal properties, notes and tasks associated with the deal); those nodes stay off until a **HubSpot account** (private app token) credential exists.
